shadows.name: application-sheet
shadows.purpose: Lift the application's working sheet above the repeated paperwork.

motion.name: flow
motion.value: comet; speed 0.85; intensity 1.75; hover true; hoverStrength 0.75

motion.name: hero-fold
motion.value: Cojeev TextReveal: fold, line split, 760ms duration, 100ms stagger; headline and demo together, then copy, then buttons on actual completion
motion.purpose: One-time kinetic hero headline on load.

motion.name: headline-mark
motion.purpose: Draw the existing lime underline after the final headline line arrives.

motion.name: section-arrival
motion.value: Cojeev MotionSurface: 700ms, cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), 22px to 0px, blur 2px to 0px; waiting content concealed before hydration with no-JavaScript/reduced-motion fallback
motion.purpose: One-time, locally scoped hero/supporting-content entrances; reduced motion settles immediately.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Lime action on a paper surface; actual runtime uses Cojeev Button.

narrative.overview: Warm paper, confident ink typography and electric lime give an exhausted applicant a lighter way into a repetitive task. The voice is playfully fed up with the process. Precise layouts support a few tilted sheets, annotations and stamps.
dos: Do keep installation, model costs and data transmission explicit.
Do keep copy grounded in the available product and distribution routes.
Do give one expressive sequence room to breathe.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, performance guarantees or application outcomes.
Don't introduce animation that gates reading or requires hover to understand content.
